prompt: Do you have connectors for Manatal, Zinc and Sonavate?
skill_note: Which providers exist is connectors territory. One of the three does not exist, which is the point.

no_reply.name: no-invented-sonavate-page
no_reply.note: There is no Sonavate connector; a URL for one is invention.

reference: Manatal has a connector; it uses API token authentication.
Zinc has a connector; it authenticates with a Zinc Partner API key used as a bearer token.
Sonavate is not a StackOne connector; the reply says so rather than inventing one.
The reply checked the current connector docs rather than assuming from memory.
